def _record_notifications(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> list[str]:
    """Capture app-level toast copy emitted by browser actions."""
    messages: list[str] = []

    def _notify(
        _app: SupervisorApp,
        message: str,
        *,
        severity: SeverityLevel = "information",
        timeout: float | None = None,
        markup: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        del severity, timeout, markup
        messages.append(message)

    monkeypatch.setattr(SupervisorApp, "notify", _notify)
    return messages


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", _RECOVERY_CASES, ids=_RECOVERY_CASE_IDS)
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_browser_failure_message_explains_code_specific_recovery(
    case: _RecoveryCase,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    error_state, error_code, expected_message = case
    messages = _record_notifications(monkeypatch)
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=_FailingBrowserController(error_state, error_code))
    app.store.browser_session.run_id = "run-browser-recovery"
    app.store.browser_session.session_id = "session-browser-recovery"
    app.store.browser_session.checkpoint = "human_review"
    app.store.browser_session.generation = 2
    app.store.browser_session.state = BrowserSessionState.INTERACTIVE

    async with app.run_test(size=(120, 40)) as pilot:
        app.action_open_view_only_preview()
        await pilot.pause()

    assert messages == [expected_message], (
        f"browser rejection {error_code!r} must explain a stable recovery action"
        f" through the operator gesture"
    )
    assert (
        app.store.browser_session.state,
        app.store.browser_session.failure_code,
    ) == (_EXPECTED_FAILURE_STATE[error_state], error_code), (
        "a rejected gesture must project the authoritative failure state and code"
    )
